section.title: How It
section.para: A simple 3-step process to exchange homes confidently and travel how you want — safely, affordably, and with peace of mind.

firstCard.title: Complete Your Profile
firstCard.para: Create your personal account and start with the plan you prefer Base (1 year) or Premium (2 years)

secondCard.title: Browse & Connect
secondCard.para: Find homes that match your criteria and connect with like-minded travelers

thirdCard.title: Enjoy Your Stay
thirdCard.para: Finalize the exchange terms on the platform and get ready for the travel!
